scenarios.scenario-1: Node CLI, React/Vite, and docs/tooling pet-project workflows are exercised and recorded.
scenarios.scenario-2: SNARC recalls relevant project decisions after restart without transcript pollution.
scenarios.scenario-3: Any blocker or repeated friction is captured as a follow-up backlog item before beta readiness.

evidence-types.evidence-1: Deterministic smoke tests validate launch, slash command metadata, SNARC endpoints, and RTK policy.
evidence-types.evidence-2: Trace assertions record commands, timestamps, workspace roots, and outcomes in the dogfooding report.
evidence-types.evidence-3: Manual integration evidence records screenshots or concise notes for UI comfort issues.

verification-levels.level-1: Run dogfooding smoke tests against disposable temporary projects.
verification-levels.level-2: Run MyGRACE slash, RTK, SNARC, MCP, and dashboard focused tests.
verification-levels.level-3: Run full test suite, build, MyGRACE lint, and review the dogfooding report before marking Phase-12 done.

telemetry-requirements.telemetry-1: Dogfooding report records exact command, result, duration, friction, and follow-up owner.
telemetry-requirements.telemetry-2: Reports must not include API keys, private prompts, or real user project secrets.

autonomous-safety.safety-1: Autonomous execution may create and mutate disposable projects only.
autonomous-safety.safety-2: Any real project mutation outside the disposable workspace blocks dogfooding completion.
autonomous-safety.safety-3: Beta readiness requires no unresolved critical or high dogfooding blockers.
